item.title: Celebrity birthdays for the week of Aug. 16-22 includes Madonna and Andrew Garfield
item.summary: Spectators watch as Madonna performs during half time of the World Cup final soccer match between Spain and Argentina in East Rutherford, N.J., near New York, Sunday, July 19, 2026.
